text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан claims victory at the
Takarazuka
Kinen and shouts her joy out
to the crowd.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин congratulates and
entrusts her
with competing in
medium-distance races for the
Mejiro
family.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...She also expresses a desire for Ryan to
become
an exquisite lady by the time of
their next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Becoming a proper lady by the year-end
Arima
Kinen means Мэдзиро Райан will be
as busy as ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
